_comment: Catalogue rows RETIRED after the HVAC taxonomy (D-113). Each was a duplicate: the eight NECB System 4 '-necbs4' rows built exactly the equipment of their System 3 row, differing only in names and sys_abbr. Each is kept VERBATIM with its position in systems.json and in the D-58 golden, so the pre-retirement files can be rebuilt and proved (tests/necb/test_reference_matrix_migration.py). A retired id stays resolvable as an alias of `into` and is never reused.
